title: CX Designer SR (10111)
description:
A pessoa CX Designer será fundamental na otimização da jornada e experiência do cliente nos canais de comunicação automatizados, com foco em WhatsApp e Chatbot, do nosso parceiro da área de Seguros.

O grande desafio como CX Designer será realizar o entendimento aprofundado do fluxo de negócio e garantir a rastreabilidade e medição de toda a experiência por meio de tagueamento (instrumentação) de dados na jornada do cliente. Este profissional atuará como guardião da experiência, transformando dados em insights para desenhar fluxos mais eficientes, intuitivos e que gerem maior satisfação e conversão.

Nosso parceiro da área de Seguros busca constantemente aprimorar o design e a operação dos sistemas para garantir que sejam mais escaláveis, confiáveis e eficientes. Então, o papel da pessoa CX Designer é bastante estratégico para o negócio.

Para que a estratégia seja assertiva, a pessoa CX Designer fará parte de uma equipe ágil composta por Desenvolvedores, Líderes Técnicos, Analistas de QA, Analistas Funcionais, Product Owners (PO) e Scrum Masters.

Garantir a Rastreabilidade da Jornada: O desafio central é desenhar e documentar detalhadamente o tagueamento (instrumentação de dados) em cada ponto de interação da jornada (WhatsApp/Chatbot), garantindo que todos os eventos e gargalos do cliente sejam corretamente identificados e mensurados para análise de dados e Business Intelligence.

Otimização Contínua do Fluxo: Identificar e reprojetar os pontos de fricção (pain points), drop-offs e repetição de ciclos na jornada, transformando interações complexas em experiências fluidas e de baixo esforço.

Equilibrar Automação e Experiência Humana: Desenhar flows que maximizem a resolução de problemas por automação, mas que garantam uma transição suave e eficiente para o atendimento humano quando necessário, mantendo a voz e a personalidade da marca.

Tradução de Requisitos de Negócio em UX Funcional: Converter objetivos de negócio complexos em arquiteturas conversacionais e fluxos de usuário simples e compreensíveis.

Requisitos

  • Empatia e Customer Centricity: Capacidade genuína de se colocar no lugar do usuário para identificar pontos de dor e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Comunicação e Relacionamento Interpessoal: Clareza para articular insights, defender propostas de design e interagir com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio.
  • Negociação e Persuasão: Habilidade para influenciar o roadmap do produto e negociar soluções de design que equilibrem a experiência do cliente com os objetivos de negócio e as restrições técnicas.
  • Resiliência e Adaptabilidade: Capacidade de navegar em ambientes dinâmicos e lidar com feedbacks e iterações rápidas, mantendo o foco na melhoria contínua.
  • Organização e Gestão de Fluxo: Proficiência em documentar, organizar e gerenciar a complexidade de fluxos de conversação e jornadas do usuário.
  • Liderança e Proatividade: Iniciativa para conduzir pesquisas, propor soluções e atuar como líder de pensamento em UX dentro da equipe.

Requisitos técnicos (hard skills)

  • Experiência Comprovada em Design Conversacional (Conversational UX/CUX): Sólida experiência no design de chatbots, URA e jornadas no WhatsApp, incluindo a criação de flows (fluxos), scripts e personas conversacionais.
  • Mapeamento de Jornada e Fluxos: Domínio em ferramentas e metodologias para mapear jornadas do usuário, blueprints de serviço e diagramas de fluxo de alta complexidade.
  • Tagueamento e Instrumentação de Dados (Analytics): Experiência em definir a estratégia e os requisitos de tagueamento (instrumentação) para mensuração de métricas de UX e negócio (ex: Drop-off Rate, Taxa de Sucesso, CSAT conversacional).
  • Prototipação e Testes: Proficiência em ferramentas de prototipação (Figma, Miro ou similar) e experiência na condução de testes de usabilidade, A/B testing e análise heurística em canais conversacionais.
  • Conhecimento de Plataformas de Chatbot/WhatsApp: Familiaridade com as limitações e capacidades de plataformas populares de construção de chatbots e APIs de WhatsApp Business.
  • UX Research: Capacidade de conduzir pesquisas qualitativas e quantitativas para fundamentar decisões de design (entrevistas, análise de logs de conversação, pesquisa de satisfação).
  • Conceitos Ágeis: Experiência de trabalho em squads ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) e colaboração estreita com Product Owners (PO) e engenheiros.

Job description

Sobre a Vaga:

Olá, somos o Grupo Destaque!

Nosso Grupo, começou suas atividades em 1967 com a abertura do escritório de contabilidade Eco. De lá para cá, em meio a turbulências ora por ordem econômica, ora por crises políticas e conflitos de ordem social, nunca deixamos de acreditar na força e potencial de nosso país.

E com muita dedicação, empenho e perseverança, conseguimos trilhar por uma trajetória de sucesso, ampliando e diversificando nossas atividades. Nascia então, o Grupo Destaque com maior enfoque em negócios do segmento automotivo, que hoje possui 36 concessionárias do segmento automobilístico com vendas e revendas de carros, manutenção e revisão de veículos, sendo composto por 13 marcas, sendo elas: Fiat, Jeep, Ram, Ford, Renault, BYD, Hyundai, Peugeot, Citroen, Toyota, Nissan, Chery e Semi Novos.

Na Alta direção, contamos com um Presidente e dois diretores; e no quadro de colaboradores temos aproximadamente 1.000 colaboradores diretos e 200 colaboradores indiretos, incluindo os cargos de liderança, vendas, pós vendas, peças e administrativo.

O Grupo Destaque, hoje referência no mercado automobilístico busca um CONSULTOR DE VENDAS para fazer parte da sua equipe.

O que esperamos de você?

Procuramos profissionais dedicados a cumprir suas metas e que tenha o propósito de ter um atendimento de excelência, garantindo a satisfação de nossos clientes, e buscando engajamento entre nossa marca X montadora.

Main responsibilities

Como será o seu dia a dia:

  • Realizar a venda de veículos novos e seminovos, observando o perfil do cliente entendendo suas necessidades;
  • Abordar o cliente no showroom com entusiasmo e entender suas necessidades para mostrar os veículos aderentes à ela;
  • Demonstrar os veículos de maneira envolvente, de maneira que o cliente tenha uma experiência única;
  • Dominar o conhecimento técnico dos produtos;
  • Convidar o cliente para a mesa para negociação, verificar todas as objeções que tem perante o veículo e contra argumentá-las para a concretização da venda;
  • Cadastrar o cliente no sistema da financeira e da concessionária para a aprovação de venda e financiamento;
  • Solicitar e recolher os documentos necessários para o faturamento e documentação do veículo (Despachante);
  • Alinhar com o cliente os recebimentos financeiros (Pagamento à vista, Consórcio, Financiamento particular, cartão de crédito, etc.);
  • Verificar o status do veículo vendido junto ao pátio;
  • Verificar se a proposta do cliente foi aprovada pela financeira;
  • Após a aprovação, direcionar o cliente para o vendedor de acessórios para a aquisição de itens opcionais;
  • Agendar com o cliente a entrega do veículo;
  • Na data estipulada, caso haja necessidade, realizar a entrega técnica do veículo, explicando todos os itens que compõe o mesmo, entregando também o manual do usuário;
  • Auxilia na organização o layout da loja;
  • Realizar a prospecção de novos clientes, via telefone, e-mail e redes sociais;
  • Realizar o atingimento de metas e acompanhar os indicadores de vendas e de satisfação do cliente, com o objetivo de melhoria contínua;
  • Oferecer test drive ao cliente, orientando o mesmo sobre o percurso mais adequado para o modelo;
  • Realizar, via sistema, a liberação do veículo ao financeiro;
  • Verificar os e-mails enviados pela gerência para atualização de processos, além de verificar o recebimento de novos leads.

Requirements and skills

O que buscamos?

Requisitos Mínimos:

  • Escolaridade: Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Experiência Profissional: 2 anos na função;
  • Conhecimentos: Pacote Office / Noções de matemática financeira / Dominar as técnicas de vendas;
  • CNH - B (Ativa).

Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Formação Acadêmica: Superior Cursando em Gestão de Negócios ou Marketing e Vendas.

Onde você irá trabalhar:

  • Terá como base a região de Valinhos.
  • Oportunidade 100% presencial;
  • Horário de trabalho: De segunda a sexta-feira das 08:00 às 18:00.

Additional information

Como aqui gostamos de pessoas, confira nossos benefícios ao fazer parte do nosso time:

  • Por aqui, cuidamos da sua saúde! Temos Assistência médica e odontológica, com suporte necessário para o seu bem estar;
  • Falando em saúde, temos parceria com a Wellhub;
  • Programas de Incentivo para cuidar do corpo e da mente;
  • Seguro Vida;
  • Remuneração compatível ao do mercado;
  • Refeitório no local;
  • Ainda temos parcerias com FACULDADES para desconto na sua mensalidade.

O Grupo Destaque é uma empresa familiar que tem como missão satisfazer nossos clientes e proporcionar uma experiência positiva e única, ao adquirir nossos bens ou serviços.

Valorizamos, a responsabilidade com os nossos clientes, fornecedores e colaboradores; tendo foco, excelência no atendimento ao cliente e buscando sempre pela melhoria contínua e cumprimento de prazos.

E nossa visão é ser referência no segmento automotivo, buscando estar sempre entre os maiores Grupos automotivos do Brasil.

  • Experiência comprovada em orçamentação de obras de infraestrutura, preferencialmente ferroviárias ou de grande porte;
  • Experiência com elaboração e análise de CPUs, planilhas orçamentárias e quantitativos;
  • Capacidade de análise crítica de projetos, propostas técnicas e metodologias construtivas;
  • Disponibilidade para eventuais viagens;
  • Domínio de ferramentas como Excel avançado, sistemas de orçamento (SICRO, SINAPI ou similares), experiência com COMPOR 90 ou software similar e leitura de projetos técnicos.

  • Análise crítica e elaboração de Composições de Preços Unitários (CPUs), avaliando insumos, coeficientes, produtividades, equipamentos e equipes envolvidas;

  • Análise técnica e econômica de propostas de obra, incluindo compatibilidade entre projetos executivos, planilhas de quantidades e critérios de medição;
  • Verificação da compatibilidade entre projetos e planilhas quantitativas, identificando desvios, omissões, sobreposições e inconsistências;
  • Elaboração e revisão de critérios de medição e pagamento, garantindo clareza contratual, aderência aos projetos e mitigação de riscos futuros;
  • Elaboração de curvas ABC para identificação dos principais ofensores do CAPEX, suportando análises de sensibilidade e priorização de esforços de otimização;
  • Desenvolvimento de estudos de otimização de custos, propondo alternativas técnicas, construtivas e logísticas visando redução de CAPEX e melhoria da viabilidade econômica dos empreendimentos;
  • Interface com as áreas de projetos, planejamento, obras, suprimentos e contratos para alinhamento técnico, validação de premissas e consolidação dos orçamentos;
  • Apoio técnico em discussões com fornecedores, projetistas, construtoras e demais áreas internas da Rumo;
  • Suporte à elaboração de materiais técnicos e executivos para reports à Gerência Executiva, incluindo análises comparativas, cenários de custo e riscos associados;
  • Atuação na melhoria contínua dos processos internos relacionados a orçamento, estimativas de custo e padronização de composições.

title: Remote Senior Sales Representative
description:
Join to apply for the Remote Senior Sales Representative role at THE/STUDIO

Global Talent Acquisition Partner | Startup Hiring

Remote – Open to candidates from anywhere in the world

Latin America preferred due to timezone alignment

Working hours: US Pacific Time

Sales experience required, with strong English communication skills

About Us

At THE/STUDIO, our vision is to empower individuals, regardless of their expertise, to unleash their creativity and bring their unique ideas to life through the production of custom products. We are committed to delivering top-quality customized products that not only exceed expectations but also provide a seamless and awe‑inspiring experience via our exceptional team and AI‑integrated systems. By shouldering the manufacturing burdens, we liberate our customers to focus on their true passions, driving them towards remarkable success and fulfillment. Together, we turn dreams into tangible realities and shape a world where creativity knows no bounds.

Our headquarters are in Los Angeles, California, but we are a truly global company with team‑members across the U.S., Europe, South America, Africa, and Asia/Pacific. We have gone to a fully remote working platform so that we can attract the world’s best talent.

All roles at THE/STUDIO are 100% remote from anywhere in the world, as long as you have all your tools and a fast, stable internet connection!

We know that some applicants will not meet all the requirements, so we encourage you to apply anyway so we can determine if something else might be a good fit!

The Role

At THE/STUDIO, we help creators and brands bring their product ideas to life: from custom hats to packaging. Our Creative Specialists are trusted advisors to our customers: they don’t just close deals, they build long-term partnerships that fuel repeat business.

We’re looking for experienced sales professionals with a strong consultative sales foundation who can confidently manage inbound opportunities, uncover deeper customer needs, and nurture accounts over time. This role is ideal for someone who already knows how to sell, structure their day, and run a pipeline; and is excited to apply those skills in a fast‑paced, remote‑first startup environment.

As a Creative Specialist, you’ll own the full inbound sales cycle while developing repeat customers by helping them grow their own businesses through THE/STUDIO’s manufacturing solutions.

What You’ll Do

  • Consult with inbound leads to deeply understand customer goals, timelines, and long‑term needs.
  • Apply a consultative sales approach to guide customers through design, pricing, and production decisions.
  • Own and manage customer accounts with a focus on nurturing repeat business and long‑term value.
  • Maintain a structured, self‑driven sales workflow with clear follow‑up cadences and prioritization.
  • Manage your pipeline in HubSpot with speed, accuracy, and strong CRM hygiene.
  • Confidently handle objections and position THE/STUDIO as the trusted alternative to “cheap but risky” sourcing options.
  • Collaborate closely with the Sales Team Lead, Production, and Design teams to ensure smooth handoffs and accurate execution.
  • Oversee order tracking, delivery coordination, and post‑sale follow‑ups to strengthen customer relationships.
  • Consistently meet and exceed KPIs and revenue targets.
  • Identify opportunities to improve sales processes, tools, and workflows as we scale.

What Success Looks Like

Within Your First Month

  • Ramp quickly and gain a strong understanding of THE/STUDIO’s value proposition and product offering.
  • Become proficient with inbound email sequencing, fast sales cadences, and CRM workflows.
  • Begin laying the groundwork for future repeat business through thoughtful follow‑ups and account notes.

Within 3 Months

  • Master how to identify, build, and nurture repeat customers with well‑defined follow‑up cadences.
  • Run a fully self‑driven, structured day‑to‑day sales workflow.
  • Proactively advise customers on how they can grow their own businesses using THE/STUDIO.
  • Demonstrate excellent CRM hygiene and clear account ownership.
  • Be recognized by teammates as someone who raises the bar and improves team productivity.

Within 6 Months

  • Own a healthy book of repeat customers who consistently come back to work with you.
  • Continuously exceed your quota and build a strong forward‑looking pipeline.
  • Identify and implement tools, methods, or sales processes that improve performance.
  • Be on track for increased responsibility and future promotion opportunities.

What We’re Looking For

  • 3–5 years of recent, quota‑carrying sales experience (not historic).
  • Strong foundation in consultative sales (Account Executive–type experience preferred).
  • Proven ability to manage and nurture customer accounts and generate repeat business.
  • Experience selling products or solutions in high‑velocity, SMB, or service‑based environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills (C1 minimum).
  • High energy, professional presence, and strong video communication skills.
  • Coachable, curious, resilient, and comfortable receiving direct feedback.
  • Interest in apparel, custom products, or manufacturing is a strong plus.
  • Experience collaborating with design teams; Adobe Illustrator knowledge is an advantage.
  • Highly organized with strong CRM discipline (HubSpot experience is a plus).
  • Self‑starter who thrives in a remote, fast‑moving startup environment.
  • Comfortable working US hours (PST and EST).
  • Remote‑ready setup: laptop/desktop with at least 8GB RAM, stable internet (10 Mbps+), and a quiet workspace for customer calls.

Note: This role is not suited for appointment setters, BDR‑only profiles, or candidates transitioning into sales from non‑sales backgrounds.

Why You’ll Love It Here

  • Fast‑growing company redefining custom manufacturing.
  • High‑quality inbound leads. NO heavy cold calling.
  • Clear metrics, dashboards, and performance transparency.
  • Real growth opportunities for top performers.
  • Competitive compensation with uncapped commissions.
  • Personalized sales training to support both your role and long‑term career growth.
  • No micromanagement: we trust experienced sellers to own their work.

On‑target earnings (OTE): $2,200+ per month (base + uncapped commissions)

Additional Attributes & Process

  • Intellectually curious – possesses a natural disposition and comfort to ask questions, challenge the status quo, and a desire to ‘get to the bottom of things’ if they see something not quite right
  • Self‑motivated with a meaningful reason to deliver excellence
  • Good communication skills that enhance collaboration, minimize misunderstandings, and at a frequency that is appropriate for a remote team
  • Radical candor – coachable, accepting of constructive negative feedback and willing to provide constructive negative feedback where applicable
  • Operates with a level of urgency – values immediate action where prudent, enables quick decision‑making, swift problem‑solving, and seizing opportunities in a dynamic business environment
  • Natural customer centricity – has an affinity to always start their train of thought or analysis with the customer’s perspective, bias toward talking to the customer to understand them
  • Results‑driven – focuses on achieving and exceeding measurable objectives
  • Submit an application. IMPORTANT: Please submit your resume/CV in English

  • Written Assessment and Mock Call
  • CEO Interview
  • Reference Check

Note that every role is different, so the process may vary depending on the requirements of the role. Regardless of the result, we always inform candidates via email.

Our policy is to provide equal opportunities for all applicants and individuals regardless of protected characteristics. description:
Remote Business Analyst (Portuguese) - 54880

Turing is one of the world’s fastest‑growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real‑world AI systems that solve mission‑critical priorities for companies.

Role Overview

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! Your role is critical in helping fine‑tune and improve large language models (like GPT), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future‑prove your career in an AI‑first world!

What does day‑to‑day look like

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day?

Requirements

  • Multilingual capabilities (English and Portuguese)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self‑motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor’s degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in data interpretation, logical reasoning and basic arithmetic is highly desirable.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting‑edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC‑8:00 (2‑5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

O grupo L'OCCITANE é uma empresa de igualdade de oportunidades. Isso significa que, ao tomar decisões sobre a carreira de nossos L'Occitaners, nossas principais considerações são sua capacidade de realizar seu trabalho e se desenvolver em suas funções. Queremos cultivar um ambiente de trabalho mais diverso e inclusivo e estamos comprometidos em construir um ambiente livre de discriminação e assédio onde todas as pessoas se sintam respeitadas e valorizadas.

Nós recrutamos pessoas de mente positiva que compartilham nossos valores fundamentais e nosso compromisso com Sustentabilidade. Venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Responsabilidades

  • Garantir a excelência no atendimento ao cliente com o objetivo de fidelizar a marca e contribuir para o atingimento de metas.

Nossa história e valores

Nossas Histórias Verdadeiras moldam quem somos. L\'OCCITANE EN PROVENCE é uma jornada que começou no sul da França, com uma história de plantas, aromas e sustentabilidade. A Brasilidade e alegria de L\'Occitane au Brésil destacam a beleza brasileira com extratos naturais, cuidado com comunidades produtoras e compromisso com cadeias sustentáveis. O grupo valoriza a sustentabilidade, o respeito ao meio ambiente, a ética e a transparência, promovendo autenticidade e protagonismo. title: Strategy Lead, YouTube Ads
description:
Minimum qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7 years of experience in advertising sales, marketing, consulting, or media (e.g., search, social, mobile, display, and video media).
  • 7 years of experience creating and presenting customer-facing materials (e.g., pitches, narratives, or one-sheets) for sales teams.
  • 7 years of experience in consumer and market insights, media measurement, and privacy landscape.
  • Ability to communicate in English and Portuguese fluently to engage with local stakeholders.

Preferred qualifications

  • 10 years of experience with social media insights data analytics.
  • Experience in product Go-to-Market (GTM) or commercial strategy roles.
  • Expertise in the Brazilian media market, including a sophisticated understanding of the TV ecosystem, viewership trends, and the competitive landscape of local broadcasters and streamers.

About The Job

Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today\'s dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.

As the YouTube Ads Strategy Lead, you will serve as the primary architect for YouTube’s product and business generation strategy in Brazil. Sitting at the intersection of Product and Sales, you function as a Product Lead within a commercial structure, driving the long-term roadmap for how YouTube competes for and wins advertising budgets.

Your strategy will be rooted in a deep, holistic understanding of the platform’s ecosystem—starting from user consumption behavior to inform monetization frameworks. You will be the go-to expert on the Brazilian media landscape, leveraging deep knowledge from traditional TV to social platforms dynamics to position YouTube as the premier choice for advertisers. You will translate complex internal data into actionable business intelligence, crafting the narratives that drive video products adoption and revenue growth.

Google's Large Customer Sales (LCS) teams are strategic partners and industry thought leaders to the world's leading brands and agencies. We continuously challenge how customers think about their business and how Google can support growth. We focus on helping these players navigate profound industry shifts and drive outsized business performance by competitively selling Google's full suite of advertising solutions across Search, YouTube, Measurement, and more. As a member of our LCS team, you'll have the unique opportunity to sell at the forefront of technology, collaborating with executives, influencing market-shaping strategies, and delivering tangible results that significantly impact major global businesses and drive the growth of Google.

Responsibilities

  • Centralize YouTube’s business generation strategy in Brazil, acting as the bridge between local sales and global teams.
  • Build a platform outlook based on user behavior, arming sales with data-driven narratives that connect consumption patterns to brand buying strategies.
  • Co-lead the annual plan, prioritizing and communicating Brazil’s business requirements to global product and engineering stakeholders.
  • Analyze data and market trends to identify opportunities, developing strategies to reach business goals.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

description:
Job Title: Global Guest Experience Coordinator

Department: Guest Experience

Working hours: Shifts range from 6 a.m. to 2 a.m., with 8-hour shifts. You will work 5 days out of 7 , including weekends depending on the rota.

Reports To: Head of Global Guest Experience / Global Guest Experience Manager

About Us

QIG is a dynamic group comprising three companies:

  • Q Global Network (QGN): A global serviced apartment agency working with suppliers around the world.
  • Aeria Apartments: A London-based serviced apartment provider.
  • QDK: Q Apartments Denmark, offering stress-free beginnings in and around Copenhagen

Together, we provide premium, fully furnished apartments for business and leisure travellers worldwide. Our mission is to deliver a seamless “home away from home” experience with unparalleled service, comfort, and convenience.

Although this position focuses on QDK, there is close cross-team collaboration across all three companies’ Guest Experience teams, ensuring we share knowledge, best practices, and consistently deliver exceptional service to both guests and suppliers.

Role Overview

The Global Guest Experience Coordinator is responsible for delivering a seamless, high-quality guest journey from pre-arrival to check-out, acting as the main point of contact for guest communication and support. The role combines exceptional customer service with effective problem-solving, ensuring issues are handled quickly, empathetically, and professionally.

Working closely with internal teams (including reservations, sales, operations, supply, and finance) and external partners such as approved suppliers, landlords, and managing agents worldwide, you will coordinate services, manage escalations, and help maintain consistent standards across the guest experience. You will also gather and analyse guest feedback, monitor partner performance, and contribute ideas to continuously improve service delivery—particularly for VIP and corporate accounts where attention to detail and discretion are essential.

Key Responsibilities

Guest Experience

  • Be the main point of contact for guests, responding to inquiries by email, phone, and live chat with professionalism and warmth.
  • Guide guests through the full journey—from pre-arrival checks to check-out—ensuring they feel supported at every stage.
  • Manage guest issues with empathy and efficiency, escalating only when necessary.
  • Liaise daily with internal department like reservations, sales and operational team as well as approved suppliers, landlords, and managing agents across the globe to ensure smooth delivery of services.
  • Communicate guest feedback and issues to suppliers clearly, ensuring timely action.
  • Build and maintain strong, positive relationships with suppliers to foster trust and collaboration.
  • Monitor supplier performance and suggest improvements to strengthen our product.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

  • Balance guest needs with operational & supplier capabilities to create win–win outcomes.
  • Anticipate challenges and take proactive steps to prevent service gaps.
  • Work closely with the reservations, supply, finance and sales teams across different regions to ensure smooth communication and coordination of guest requirements or special requests.

Feedback Collection & Reporting:

  • Encourage guests to complete feedback surveys and track satisfaction trends.
  • Share insights with internal teams and suppliers to drive ongoing service enhancements.
  • Contribute ideas and recommendations for improving the overall guest and supplier experience.
  • VIP & Corporate Account Management:
  • Handle the needs of high-profile, VIP guests, or corporate accounts, ensuring that all special requirements are met, from booking preferences to additional services.

Qualifications & Competencies

Experience:

  • Minimum 3 years in guest relations, hospitality, account management, or supplier coordination.
  • Background in serviced apartments, hotels, or travel services beneficial.

Skills:

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and negotiation abilities.
  • Ability to prioritise and manage multiple stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in CRM or guest/supplier management systems.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English required; Spanish highly beneficial.

Personal Attributes:

  • Empathetic, approachable, and culturally sensitive.
  • Confident in managing expectations for both guests and suppliers.
  • Proactive and adaptable in a fast-paced global environment.
  • Collaborative team player with a passion for service excellence.

Education:

  • Degree in Hospitality, Business, or related field desirable but not essential.

Why Join Us?

  • Bridge Role Impact: Play a key part in delivering exceptional experiences by supporting both guests and suppliers.
  • Global Exposure: Work with diverse clients and partners across multiple regions.
  • Dynamic Culture: Join a friendly, collaborative team where new ideas are celebrated.
  • Competitive Package: Attractive salary and benefits.

title: Supply Chain Analyst - Capacity Planning
description:
About Latitude.sh

Latitude.sh global computing platform was launched in 2019, enabling businesses to programmatically deploy single-tenant Bare Metal instances in different parts of the world.

We are a team of passionate individuals about hardware, software, and network infrastructure looking to build the fastest, easiest-to-use, developer-centric single‑tenant Cloud infrastructure. If you share this passion, join our growing team of talented people and help build the future of the Internet.

Summary

The Supply Chain Analyst will play a key role in developing and managing Latitude.sh’s capacity planning and vendor analysis framework across global data center operations — including space, power, network, and servers. Working closely with Procurement, Operations, and Finance teams, the analyst will anticipate capacity requirements, evaluate vendor proposals, and deliver clear reporting that guides infrastructure and procurement strategy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Capacity Planning & Forecasting
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive capacity planning models for data center space, power, servers, and network resources such as IP transit and backbone connectivity.
  • Forecast utilization to identify where capacity constraints may occur across the global portfolio.
  • Track provisioned versus active usage and provide early visibility into expansion needs.
  • Maintain dashboards showing available capacity, forecasted growth, and expected exhaustion timelines by site and service type.
  • Vendor Evaluation & Cost Analysis
  • Analyze and compare vendor proposals and quotes for data center colocation, IP transit, backbone, and related network services.
  • Build standardized cost‑comparison models to identify the most cost‑efficient vendor options.
  • Support procurement decisions with clear, data‑driven recommendations and total cost analyses.
  • Monitor vendor pricing, terms, and performance to ensure competitiveness and long‑term value.
  • Operational Reporting & Insights
  • Develop and manage a monthly reporting package or dashboard showing month‑over‑month and year‑over‑year variances in data center and network costs, and aggregate breakdowns by region, vendor, and service category.
  • Compare committed capacity versus billed actuals to identify underutilized or overextended resources and ensure full use of contracted commitments.
  • Validate and reconcile data across Finance and Operations to ensure reporting accuracy.
  • Present insights and recommendations that inform vendor selection, cost optimization, and capacity planning across teams.

Skills And Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Finance, Engineering, Economics, or a related field (or equivalent combination of education and work experience).
  • 2+ years of experience in supply chain analysis, capacity planning, cost management, or financial analysis, ideally within technology, telecommunications, or data center environments.
  • Strong proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets (pivot tables, lookups, scenario modeling).
  • Experience using data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker Studio.
  • Fluent in Portuguese, with professional‑level English (written and spoken).
  • Background in data center operations, network procurement, or telecom cost modeling (IP transit, dark fiber, backbone).

Preferred

  • Familiarity with ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Oracle) and SQL or other data tools.
  • Exposure to DCIM, NetBox, or other infrastructure inventory systems.
  • Highly analytical and detail‑oriented, with strong quantitative reasoning.
  • Organized and methodical, capable of structuring complex datasets into clear insights.
  • Proactive and forward‑looking, anticipating capacity and cost challenges.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, effective with both technical and business audiences.
  • Collaborative and dependable, thriving in a dynamic, global environment.

What do we offer?

  • Competitive Compensation
  • Annual Bonus based on company and team performance
  • Meal voucher (Caju): R$805,22/monthly
  • Wellhub
  • Transportation or fuel voucher (without discounts)
  • Health Plan (Sulamérica)
  • Dental Plan (Amil)
  • Subsidies for education, certification and English courses
  • On‑site at Vila Mariana - São Paulo - SP

Why Latitude.sh?

We're a lean, agile team of passionate professionals who believe in the power of innovation and creative problem‑solving. As part of our team, you won't be lost in the crowd – you'll be an essential contributor, making a real impact from day one.

Our values at Latitude.sh guide us in all our work and partnerships. We're proud to be an inclusive company, and we welcome all applicants for our open positions, regardless of their background, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, nationality or disability. If these values speak to you, we'd love for you to become a part of our team.

title: Regional Automation Engineer, Amazon Reliability Maintenance Engineering - IntlRME
description:
Overview

DESCRIPTION: Amazon Operations sits at the heart of the Amazon customer experience. We look after everything from the moment a customer clicks buy, to the moment their item is delivered – from desktop to doorstep. Amazon has several Fulfillment Centers, Sort Centers and Delivery Stations, thousands of machines, and thousands of employees, all working together in harmony to make sure the right item gets delivered to the right person, in the right place, at the right time. Working in Amazon Operations is for people who like to be active and give their all. We work in a busy, dynamic environment and are part of a bigger team delivering on the expectations of millions of customers every single day. We are open, inclusive and welcome individuality and diversity. Our teams take pride in a job well done, looking out for one another, ensuring the highest safety standards and playing their part in delivering the quality service Amazon is known for around the world.

Join us in the Amazon Reliability Maintenance Engineering team. We maintain and optimize technologies in the Global Amazon Warehouse & Delivery Network.

Purpose Of The Job

We are looking for motivated, customer-focused people who want to join our team as an Automation Engineer (AE). The focus of the AE role is to fault find, troubleshoot and improve controls solutions for automated material handling equipment such as conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print and apply systems, scales, Human-Machine Interface (HMI) systems, and control cabinets. The AE will also provide training to the Engineering Technicians on device troubleshooting and preventive maintenance.

Responsibilities

  • Be the site level Subject Matter Expert (SME) for all controls systems and sensors within the building. Work in a hands-on manner to actively monitor, fault find and repair systems in order to provide a high level of equipment availability to internal customers.
  • Train technicians in the basics of control systems fault finding in order to raise the level of knowledge within the site.
  • Work within the Global Controls network to enhance the capability to monitor Material Handling Equipment (MHE) metrics and provide visualization and data to internal customers by means of troubleshooting and prioritizing.
  • Actively participate in or own continuous improvement projects coordinated by the Global Controls network.
  • Work with Global Controls Engineering and Operations Engineering to ensure all systems are correctly documented and that accurate backup libraries are maintained.
  • Work alongside global teams to support the installation and commission of new equipment.
  • Support other sites in the Brazil network as required.
  • Interpreting both mechanical and electrical drawings and understanding and developing improvement strategies for code conforming.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree;
  • Experience with PLC controlled automation and issue diagnosis in a continuous process or production environment;
  • Experience in dealing with material handling, flow and capacity;
  • Experience in written and spoken English;
  • Experience supporting a wide range of different conveyors and sortation systems;
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, SolidWorks, Ignition, Visio and AutoCAD.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a multi-site environment;
  • Experience in project management;
  • Knowledge of process improvement, ideally including Lean, Kaizen and Six Sigma;
  • Electrical or mechanical training degree in computer science, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or related fields;
  • Understanding of ISO 13849 & 62061.

description:
Uma empresa de referência no setor de transporte aéreo, reconhecida pela excelência em atendimento. Com o apoio estratégico de Claire Joster, especialista em recrutamento, buscamos um profissional técnico para integrar nossa equipe de suprimentos e contribuir para operações de alta performance e segurança.

Objetivo da Posição

Responsável pela gestão estratégica de compras de peças, componentes, equipamentos e serviços críticos para a operação e manutenção aeronáutica. O profissional garantirá o equilíbrio entre custo, qualidade e conformidade, assegurando o suporte contínuo às operações de voo e à manutenção da frota, em linha com as rígidas normas do setor (ANAC, FAA, EASA).

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Executar todo o ciclo de compras: identificação de necessidade, cotação, negociação, aquisição e acompanhamento de entregas de materiais aeronáuticos e serviços especializados.
  • Analisar especificações técnicas e desenhos de engenharia para validar a conformidade de itens com os requisitos de segurança e qualidade.
  • Desenvolver e gerir o relacionamento com fornecedores homologados nacionais e internacionais, assegurando performance e parcerias estratégicas.
  • Elaborar e administrar contratos de fornecimento, com atenção a cláusulas técnicas, de segurança e comerciais.
  • Colaborar diretamente com as equipes de Engenharia, Manutenção (MRO) e Planejamento para alinhar demandas, prazos e especificações.
  • Implementar iniciativas de redução de custos e otimização de processos de suprimentos, sem comprometer a integridade operacional.
  • Gerenciar os níveis de estoque de peças críticas, prevenindo situações de ruptura (AOG – Aircraft on Ground) e otimizando o capital.
  • Assegurar a conformidade de todos os processos com as regulamentações aeronáuticas vigentes e com os procedimentos internos de qualidade e segurança.
  • Dominar o uso de sistemas de gestão (ERP, SAP) e plataformas especializadas do setor (ex.: ILS, AeroXchange) para cadastro, rastreamento e aquisição de peças.
  • Atuar como ponto de contato técnico-comercial para resolver problemas de qualidade, atrasos ou não-conformidades com fornecedores.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Formação: Bacharelado em Engenharia (Aeronáutica, Mecânica, Produção, Materiais ou áreas correlatas).
  • Experiência Comprovada em funções de compras, suprimentos ou supply chain no setor de transporte aéreo, aviação ou aeroespacial .
  • Conhecimento sólido das normas regulatórias da aviação civil (ANAC, FAA, EASA).
  • Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de documentação técnica (manuais, catálogos de peças, desenhos) em inglês .
  • Habilidade avançada em ferramentas de gestão e análise: ERP (SAP, Oracle, TOTVS) e Excel (funções complexas, dashboards).
  • Competências sólidas em negociação estratégica, análise de custos e gestão de contratos.
  • Perfil proativo, analítico e com orientação rigorosa para detalhes, essencial em um ambiente de alta criticidade.

Diferenciais (Desejáveis)

  • Pós-graduação ou certificações em Compras, Supply Chain Management ou Gestão de Projetos.
  • Experiência com processos de importação/exportação de peças aeronáuticas e trâmites aduaneiros.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de catálogos de peças aeronáuticas (PartsBase, Inventory Locator Service).
  • Vivência em processos de homologação e auditoria de fornecedores no setor aeroespacial.
  • Inglês fluente para comunicação comercial e técnica com fornecedores internacionais.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Pensamento Crítico e Resolução de Problemas: capacidade de tomar decisões ágeis e precisas sob pressão.
  • Comunicação Efetiva: habilidade para dialogar com diferentes áreas (técnicas e comerciais) e níveis hierárquicos.
  • Ética e Integridade Inegociáveis , aderente à cultura de segurança e compliance da aviação.
  • Organização e Orientação a Prazos: disciplina para gerenciar múltiplas demandas críticas simultaneamente.
  • Trabalho em Equipe: espírito colaborativo para atuar em um ambiente multidisciplinar e dinâmico.

title: FinCrime Operations Team Lead
description:
This is Adyen

Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.

For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

The role

As a FinCrime leader (referred to at Adyen as an AML & Screening leader) for the Sao Paulo hub, you will execute Adyen’s global financial crime compliance strategy and drive the continuous enhancement of controls that safeguard our banking products, acquiring flows, issuing programs, and capital underwriting. In close partnership with Fraud, Risk, Product, Compliance, and global operations teams, you will translate regulatory expectations, data, and intelligence into scalable, intelligence‑led solutions that strengthen the end‑to‑end merchant risk lifecycle. Your leadership will directly enable Adyen’s growth by ensuring a secure, trusted, and compliant platform for merchants worldwide, operating in strong counterbalance and collaboration with Fraud prevention to deliver holistic FinCrime coverage.

What you’ll do

  • Lead, develop, and scale a high‑performing AML & Screening team (10 FTE), ensuring clear ownership, structured workflows, strong coaching, and a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Oversee complex AML and sanctions investigations end‑to‑end, including transaction analysis, customer due diligence, adverse media review, escalation handling, and SAR recommendations across acquiring, issuing, banking, and capital products.
  • Monitor emerging AML, sanctions, and FinCrime typologies and regulatory developments, translating insights into improved controls, risk coverage, and operational readiness.
  • Implement and continuously enhance AML & Screening policies, procedures, and controls across transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, investigations, escalation, and regulatory reporting, aligned with Fraud and broader FinCrime strategy.
  • Drive operational excellence using data insights, automation, quality assurance, and root‑cause analysis, while partnering cross‑functionally to deliver scalable monitoring and detection capabilities.
  • Build team capability through hiring, performance management, training, mentorship, and clear communication that supports professional growth and sustained high performance.
  • Provide performance visibility through outcome tracking, senior stakeholder reporting, audit and regulatory support, and execution of global AML & Screening priorities.

Who you are

  • 6+ years of experience in AML, Screening, or broader Financial Crime within a financial institution, PSP, issuing bank, or fintech, including demonstrated people‑leadership skills.
  • Proven leader with a track record of building, mentoring, and motivating high‑performing teams, driving accountability, development, and a strong performance culture.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving capability, able to interpret complex data, identify risk trends, and make sound, risk‑based decisions in a KPI‑driven environment.
  • Experienced in designing scalable processes, controls, and operational improvements, while managing investigations and screening activities with precision and attention to detail.
  • Effective communicator and collaborative partner, comfortable operating in fast‑moving global environments, presenting to senior stakeholders, and adapting to evolving priorities; payments or FinTech experience preferred and willingness to travel internationally as required.
  • Payments, banking, or FinTech experience is strongly preferred.
  • Full professional proficiency in English with clear written and verbal communication skills; able to present insights to senior stakeholders.
  • Willingness to travel internationally as required.

Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments

Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.

Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!

What’s next?

Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here. Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.

This role is based out of our Sao Paulo office. We are an office‑first company and value in‑person collaboration; we do not offer remote‑only roles.

We are seeking a Senior QA Engineer with a strong software QA background (not hardware) to lead, build, and scale quality assurance processes for complex enterprise software. This role involves driving test strategy, mentoring team members, and championing automation and DevOps integration in a fast‑paced Agile environment.

  • Lead the planning and execution of manual and automated functional, regression, exploratory, and system‑level tests across the software lifecycle.
  • Develop, maintain, and optimise automated UI and API test suites using Selenium, Postman, JMeter, and gRPC.

  • Document, manage, and triage defects using Azure DevOps, ensuring clarity and timely resolution.
  • Act as a quality owner for key product features, ensuring traceability from requirements to release.
  • Build and maintain a scalable, reusable automation test library and produce meaningful test coverage reports.
  • Mentor junior QA engineers in both manual and automated test design, process, and tooling.

Ama quebrar as objeções e fazer o cliente perceber que sua solução é a melhor opção?

Na 4blue, nosso propósito é claro: transformar a vida de empresários e construir um mundo onde empreender vale a pena. Desde 2009, nos consagramos como referência em Gestão Empresarial para pequenas e médias empresas , ajudando empresários a tirar seus sonhos do papel e alcançar resultados reais .

  • Home office: mais tempo no seu dia. O que dá pra fazer com 1 a 2 horas a mais no dia? Tem gente que acredita que trabalhar de casa não funciona, aqui provamos que dá sim pra trabalhar de casa com foco e com resultado, mas com muito mais qualidade de vida.

Sobre a vaga:
O Consultor Comercial (Closer) é responsável por conduzir reuniões e negociações comerciais, gerenciar o relacionamento com clientes, pelo fechamento de contratos, bem como ajudar a melhorar o processo de vendas para aumentas as taxas de conversão. Sua missão é VENDER!

  • Atualização e Gestão do CRM: Registrar as interações e status dos leads, mantendo um controle preciso do funil de vendas;
  • Participação em Treinamentos e Desenvolvimento: Estar em constante desenvolvimento, participando de treinamentos e melhorando as habilidades que aumentem suas taxas de conversão;
  • Apoio ao Time e Melhoria de Processos: Ajudar o time com insights sobre leads, auxiliar na preparação de estratégias de vendas, dar sugestões para melhoria do processo comercial;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens eventuais para participação em eventos presenciais.

As comissões, na média, vão de 3 mil reais a 7 mil reais por mês, porém não há um teto na remuneração, logo estes valores podem se tornar muito superior a depender da performance.O que buscamos de um futuro Blue:

O frentista desempenha um papel vital em um posto de combustível, sendo frequentemente a primeira impressão que os clientes têm da qualidade do serviço. Além de atender com simpatia e profissionalismo, o frentista deve também ser um vendedor habilidoso , capaz de identificar as necessidades dos clientes e oferecer soluções que agreguem valor. Essa habilidade vai além de uma simples transação; é sobre construir relacionamentos e criar confiança.

No Grupo Schueng, reconhecemos e recompensamos o esforço de nossos frentistas. Por isso, criamos um programa exclusivo de vendas que permite aos colaboradores participar dos lucros das vendas de produtos (exceto combustíveis), possibilitando alcançar níveis de comissão muito acima do mercado atual.

Para integrar nossa equipe, é desejável ter, no mínimo, o ensino médio completo e realizar cursos especializados, como NR20, atendimento ao cliente, NR07, NR09 e NR23. Esses treinamentos garantem a preparação técnica e a segurança necessárias para desempenhar a função com excelência.

A soma dessas qualidades e habilidades transforma o frentista do Grupo Schueng em um verdadeiro embaixador de nossa missão: proporcionar atendimento de qualidade, com eficiência e dedicação, sempre pensando no melhor para o cliente.

Responsabilidades

Trabalhar como frentista no Grupo Schueng vai muito além do abastecimento. Você será uma peça fundamental para garantir a satisfação dos clientes e a excelência dos serviços prestados. Suas principais atividades incluem:

  • Abastecer veículos: Realizar o abastecimento de forma segura e eficiente, garantindo a satisfação e confiança do cliente.
  • Atender clientes: Realizar o atendimento seguindo o padrão de excelência do Grupo Schueng, iniciando sempre com um caloroso: Seja bem-vindo ao Grupo Schueng. Demonstrar cordialidade, atenção e criar uma experiência agradável em cada interação.
  • Auxiliar no pagamento: Orientar os clientes sobre formas de pagamento e operar sistemas de recebimento com precisão.
  • Limpar e manter veículos: Realizar pequenos serviços de limpeza, como o para-brisas, para proporcionar um diferencial no atendimento.
  • Verificar a qualidade do combustível: Garantir que o combustível esteja em conformidade com os padrões de qualidade do Grupo Schueng.
  • Calibrar pneus: Ajudar os clientes a manterem a segurança de seus veículos com o ajuste adequado da pressão dos pneus.
  • Trocar óleo: Oferecer serviços de troca de óleo com cuidado e profissionalismo, sempre respeitando as necessidades do cliente.
  • Limpar para-brisas: Proporcionar maior visibilidade e segurança aos motoristas com um serviço simples, mas eficiente.
  • Testar a iluminação dos automóveis: Auxiliar na verificação de faróis, lanternas e outros sistemas de iluminação dos veículos.
  • Organizar e manter todas as dependências da unidade limpas: Garantir um ambiente sempre limpo, organizado e convidativo para os clientes e colaboradores.
  • Responsabilidade em cada abastecimento: Cada vez que você realiza um abastecimento, está assumindo um papel essencial na experiência do cliente. É fundamental garantir que o combustível correto (gasolina, diesel, etanol ou outros) seja utilizado com total atenção e que o valor recebido esteja exato, garantindo a precisão do seu turno no sistema de controle.
  • Zelar por equipamentos: Cuidar dos patrimônios da unidade é uma responsabilidade essencial que reflete seu compromisso com a excelência. Manter os equipamentos em bom estado, prevenindo danos e preservando sua funcionalidade, é uma atitude que garante a qualidade do serviço e a segurança de todos.

Essas atividades e muitas outras que podem não estar aqui listadas são realizadas com o suporte dos nossos padrões rigorosos de qualidade e segurança e o líder da unidade, que refletem o compromisso do Grupo Schueng em oferecer um serviço diferenciado e de excelência.

SOBRE A PRASO

A Praso nasceu pequena, mas com uma missão gigante: colocar pequenos varejistas passos a frente no caminho do sucesso. Olhávamos para lojistas ao redor do Brasil e acreditávamos que, do jeito que estavam, as coisas não eram justas: em um mercado concentrado, donos de negócio ao redor do país sofriam com longas filas, baixo acesso a crédito e péssimo serviço na hora de abastecer os seus negócios. O propósito da Praso é muito maior que ela mesma: com trabalho duro, queremos provar que é possível construir algo no Nordeste que atrai o interesse do mundo. Atualmente temos investidores ao redor do mundo que já realizaram aportes em empresas como TikTok, Nubank e Figma. title: [Banco de Talentos] Executive Assistant
description:
Banco de Talentos Executive Assistant

Boston Consulting Group (BCG)

Locations: São Paulo | Rio de Janeiro

Who We Are
Boston Consulting Group (BCG) helps leaders in business and society address their most critical challenges and unlock major opportunities. Since pioneering business strategy in 1963, we’ve supported clients through large-scale transformations that drive growth, strengthen competitive advantage, and deliver measurable impact.

What You’ll Do
This on-site position based in São Paulo or Rio de Janeiro requires an Executive Assistant (EA) who operates with a high degree of autonomy to support senior consultants. Responsibilities include:

  • Managing calendars, effectively prioritizing demands, and anticipating needs.
  • Coordinating travel, scheduling meetings, tracking time and expenses.
  • Supporting internal consulting team processes and navigating a fast‑paced rhythm.
  • Contributing actively to office dynamics and supporting other functions when needed.

Responsibilities

  • Provide high-level executive support to senior leaders in a fast-paced and constantly evolving environment. Attention to detail and accuracy are essential, especially under pressure.
  • Proactively anticipate, plan, and coordinate end-to-end travel, always acting with foresight and preparing for future needs.
  • Exercise sound judgment and make decisions independently, maintaining a diplomatic and mature approach when handling complex and occasionally challenging demands.
  • Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, demonstrating genuine people focus and a positive attitude.
  • Act as a true partner to executives and leaders, ensuring they have the information they need, supporting time prioritization, and engaging the right people at the right moment.
  • This description covers the core responsibilities but does not limit other activities inherent to the role.

What You’ll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree and preferably a minimum of 2 years of experience in fast-paced environments supporting senior executives.
  • Demonstrated experience in leadership and/or client service, with excellent interpersonal communication.
  • Strong time and project management skills, with the ability to handle multiple simultaneous demands in an organized and structured manner.
  • Ability to manage behind-the-scenes operations and develop creative solutions, contributing to a high standard of service and impact in client work.
  • Intellectual curiosity and critical thinking, seeking to understand the broader context beyond immediate tasks.
  • Fluent communication in Portuguese and English, both written and spoken, with clarity and professionalism at all organizational levels.

Além disso, o consultor deve acompanhar o processo de venda, gerenciar o relacionamento com os clientes e colaborar com a organização do showroom.   • Negociar termos e condições de venda, preparando propostas e contratos.
  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos com clientes existentes, buscando oportunidades para upsell e cross-sell.
  • Acompanhar o ciclo completo de vendas, desde a geração de leads até o fechamento do contrato.
  • Analisar as necessidades dos clientes e recomendar soluções que agreguem valor e atendam às suas expectativas.
  • Monitorar e reportar as tendências do mercado e a concorrência, ajustando estratégias conforme necessário.
  • Garantir a organização do Showroom da loja e movimentar quando necessário para ambientação, tanto para mostrar ao cliente como para manter a loja ambientada.
  • Cumprir com as metas e objetivos de vendas estabelecidos pela empresa.
  • Garantir a satisfação do cliente, oferecendo suporte pós-venda e solucionando eventuais problemas.
  • Participar de treinamentos e eventos relacionados para aprimorar habilidades e conhecimentos sobre produtos e técnicas de vendas.
